text:
Type: abstract patterned throw pillow
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, contemporary, glam
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with metallic dot accents
Colors: muted purple, grey, gold flecks
Shape: square, overlapping arc and circle pattern with scattered dots, knife edges, large
Feel: rich, subtle, sophisticated
Goes with: grey sofas, plum or lavender accents, brass, dark wood; modern or glam bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Abstract Decorative Throw Pillow, 20" x 20", Purple
product.description: Various tones of purple, green, and black yarns are woven to form abstract circles on this eye-catching pillow. For a different look, it reverses to a solid grey side. This pillow will liven up a transitional or modern style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
